newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabian shares down in subdued trading.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabian shares down in subdued trading.

text.p: Saudi shares lost about 2.7 percent last week in subdued trading focused on services sector shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Saturday.
The index ended the week at 161.13 points from 165.58 points a week earlier.
Of the 59 companies traded, 9 rose, 45 declined and five were unchanged.
Services sector shares accounted for 34 percent of trading, which BFA put at 6.46 million shares worth 1.26 billion riyals.

Saudi Cement was the most active share accounting for 15.6 percent of turnover volume and 17.9 percent of total trading value. Saudi Cement share price ended the week lower at 203 riyals from 220 riyals last week.

Among major gainers in the week were Amiantit which gained 6.7 percent to 80 riyals from 75 riyals a week earlier, National Gypsum which ended the week three percent higher at 340 riyals from 330 riyals the previous week.
Eastern Cement declined by 12 percent closing at 373 riyals from 424 riyals and Saudi Hotels slipped by 11.2 percent to 127 riyals from 143 riyals.
